claims.source_title: How do you qualify for the 2028 Vendée Globe?
claims.supporting_quote: The system may be described in these terms, and no further: 9.1 — finish a solo race. Each skipper-boat pair must have finished, with a ranking, at least ONE solo race from this list, on the boat they will race in the Vendée Globe, in no more than twice the first finisher's time.
